snippet.title: Super Meat Boy 3D - Release Date Announcement Trailer | Xbox Partner Preview 2026
snippet.description:
The infamous, tough-as-nails platformer – now in 3D! Super Meat Boy 3D launches this Tuesday, March 31, 2026.

Super Meat Boy 3D is coming to Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC as an Xbox Play Anywhere title and with Xbox Game Pass.
